title: Attach the twin's valid proof to an acceptRun call with result r + 1
verdictRule: REJECT = the node refuses the attempt at submission with a counted ledger refusal (not a pool ban, fee, DUST, TTL or balance failure), its transaction hash is absent from the selected network's indexer, the native proof-verifying ledger 9.1.0.1 predictor (validate_call) refuses it at the stage named in networkCheck, MAIN's indexed state is unchanged across the mutants, and the same-session positive control (a fresh valid acceptRun on MAIN) finalized. A local precheck or SDK refusal never counts. Nothing passes unless the positive control finalized.

target.contract: SherlockRun (tools/sherlock-sdk/sherlock-run.compact); MAIN, OTHER-PROGRAM and OTHER-INIT addresses sealed per network in qa/holdout/config/networks.json
target.evidenceProducer: the network's rejectOperation (OP-UD-REJECT, OP-PV-REJECT, OP-MN-REJECT): scripts/doctorwatson heavy --id <op> -- node tools/sherlock-sdk/call-run.mjs --network <net> --reject-suite (task 6.1, E13); receipt committed at qa/sherlock/receipt-traces/<op>/receipt.json
target.checker: qa/holdout/lib/network_check.py (read-only: committed receipt + the selected network's public indexer)

mutation.description: the twin's valid proof on a call whose public result is r + 1 (the statement differs from the proved one)

expectedTargetBehavior: node refuses at submission; transaction hash absent from the indexer; MAIN state unchanged; the same-session twin finalizes

seed.note: Network definitions by the evaluator, 2026-11-08 (E12), from SRC-007, the SherlockRun source and the local five-refusal check; owner decision 2026-11-08 (Preview is the test network, Mainnet the target, stagenet retired).

requirementRefs: openspec/changes/sherlock-vm-consensus-20261107/workflow.md (section 6, Rejections row: A9p rejections-preview, A9m non-consuming cases only)
tools/sherlock-sdk/check-local-run.mjs (the same five refusals on the local ledger, A6-shape)
rationale: A proof binds the whole public statement [prog_d, init_d, fin_d, n_steps, result_be]; reusing it for another result must fail proof verification. Non-consuming.
positiveControl: Same-session twin: a fresh valid acceptRun on MAIN, submitted after the pre-twin mutants, indexed once with SUCCESS as an acceptRun ContractCall on the sealed MAIN address; MAIN's indexed state at preActionTx hashes to the receipt's preStateSHA256 and is unchanged across the mutants.
